text:
maya: Quick ask — can I get a 1h console sudo to pull logs for ticket LEG-412? Need to redact PII before sharing with legal.
devin: What exact scope? Which prod cluster / indices?
maya: prod-a / logs-index-2026, specifically request_id=abc123. Will only pull matching docs.
jess: Tagging sec for JIT: @sec-bot please advise process. I can review redaction after pull.
sec-bot: Please add an access justification and attach supporting docs. Follow runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/jit-access. Auditor will be notified.
maya: Added justification to the ticket: https://redwood.atlassian/browse/LEG-412. Request: 60m console sudo to run:
```
./elastic-pull --index logs-index-2026 --query "request_id:abc123" --out /tmp/leg-412.json
```
devin: Confirm redaction plan — we'll use regex to remove emails and SSNs, then run checksum and a diff sample. jess: I'll run the redaction script and sanity-check a sample.
oncall: Approving 1-hour elevated window for maya on prod-a constrained to read-only and SCP to /tmp only. No exports outside the cluster. POV to security.
sec-bot: Granting ephemeral role 'jit-log-reader' to maya for 60m. Audit entry: AR-1753456789. Compliance notified.
audit-bot: Access window recorded. Actions logged to /var/log/jit-access.log and retained per policy.
maya: Thanks — pulling now, will DM with a 5-line sample before handing to legal.
jess: Ping me when sample ready, I'll run the redact and sanity checks.
legal-svcs: Once redacted, upload to a pre-authorized S3 bucket and email legal-svcs@redwood.com with chain-of-custody notes.
maya: Will do. :thumbsup:
